title: The selected coordinate is free
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign-valued Boolean variables, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction for which the restricted function is nonconstant. The first coordinate in the support of the first term compatible with $\rho$, among coordinates left free by $\rho$, is itself free under $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ variables
The function restricted by $\rho$ is nonconstant
